import json, tempfile, time, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import sys

repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/"src"))
from do_again.service import liveness

config=liveness._settings(repo)
if not config.get("continuous"):
    raise SystemExit("continuous mode is not enabled")
if not config.get("report_stalls"):
    raise SystemExit("stall issue reporting is not enabled")

now=time.time()
seed={
    "receipt_id":"live-stall-proof",
    "progress_at":now-(config["idle_seconds"]+config["recovery_seconds"]+60),
    "attempts":2,
    "last_resume_at":now-(config["recovery_seconds"]+60),
    "state":"recovering",
}

decided, action=liveness._decision(
    seed,
    receipt_id="live-stall-proof",
    receipt_time=seed["progress_at"],
    pending=False,
    busy=False,
    now=now,
    idle_seconds=config["idle_seconds"],
    recovery_seconds=config["recovery_seconds"],
)
print("decision_action="+action)
print("decision_state="+str(decided.get("state")))
if action!="report" or decided.get("state")!="stalled":
    raise SystemExit("bounded watchdog did not classify deliberate no-progress as reportable stall")

first=liveness._report_stall(repo,config,dict(decided),reason="idle")
print("first_report="+json.dumps(first,sort_keys=True))
if first.get("issue_report") not in {"created","existing"} or not first.get("issue_number"):
    raise SystemExit("stall reporter did not surface a visible issue")

# Fresh state simulates restart: dedupe must discover the same open issue instead of creating another.
fresh=dict(decided)
fresh.pop("issue_number",None)
fresh.pop("issue_report",None)
fresh.pop("next_report_at",None)
second=liveness._report_stall(repo,config,fresh,reason="idle")
print("second_report="+json.dumps(second,sort_keys=True))
if second.get("issue_report")!="existing":
    raise SystemExit("restart-style stall report was not deduplicated")
if second.get("issue_number")!=first.get("issue_number"):
    raise SystemExit("dedupe resolved to a different issue")

# Reporter state is the local no-secrets incident trace for this proof. Validate it contains no repo parent path.
blob=json.dumps({"first":first,"second":second},sort_keys=True)
if str(repo.parent) in blob:
    raise SystemExit("local stall report state leaked parent path")

print(json.dumps({
    "issue_number":first.get("issue_number"),
    "first_issue_report":first.get("issue_report"),
    "second_issue_report":second.get("issue_report"),
    "decision_state":decided.get("state"),
    "recovery_seconds":config["recovery_seconds"],
    "idle_seconds":config["idle_seconds"],
},indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print("LIVE_STALL_VISIBLE_INCIDENT_ACCEPTANCE_OK")
